exposure: Use of augmentation or epidural anaesthesia
cohort: 45,893 women with an intact uterus and 5630 with uterine scars at the Kaunas Perinatal Centre from 2004-2019
finding: The incidence of uterine rupture was 6.8 per 10,000 deliveries, with a higher incidence in women with a uterine scar (44.4 per 10,000 births).
